That's kind of the fun stuff you can get into a novel that you can't always get onto the screen.|Rian Johnson|{{StarWarsShow|52L2HML5O1k|The Last Jedi Novelization to Feature Deleted Scenes, Star Wars Day at Sea, and More!|sw_url=video/the-last-jedi-novelization-to-feature-deleted-scenes-star-wars-day-at-sea-and-more}} }} '''''Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition''''' is the novelization of the [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. Written by [[Jason Fry]], with input from director [[Rian Johnson]], the novelization includes deleted scenes and other additional content. The book was first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover and eBook formats on [[March 6]], [[2018]]. An [[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition (audiobook)|audiobook]] version narrated by [[Marc Thompson]] was released on the same day. Later a paperback edition was released on [[November 27]], 2018.
